column16: km77 own measurements (Ford Edge 2016, EU): boot depth 97-102 cm, width 114-135 cm, load edge 73 cm; rear-seat room
column21: Volume = maker 1847 L roof-high (VDA) = 65.2 cu ft (ADAC measured 1730 L roof-high, 965 L to window line). US SAE 73.4 cu ft. Folded length: forum owner measured 72 in (±1 in) from inside of the closed tailgate to the back of the front seats; carwiki gives 1885 mm, dealer page 74.8 in — smaller (72 in) kept. Width 45 in is between the wheel wells per the owner ('you could add another 6" to the width' without them); matches km77 114 cm. Height: no source gives a separate folded height; the boot height figure is reused because the opening/liftgate rake is the limit for items loaded from the rear. Width 114 cm is the between-wheel-arch minimum (km77 gives 114-135 cm min/max; carwiki 1140 mm; kofferraum.org 114 cm agree). Height: carwiki 710-870 mm vs kofferraum.org 80 cm; >50 mm apart so the smaller 710 mm kept — likely limited by the steeply raked liftgate (TCS notes the sloped tailgate limits volume). All sources are the EU-built CD539 Edge (2016+); body is the same as US 2015-2024. Rear seat does not slide.
